title: Drawing on the Powers of Heave: The Principles That Govern Faith
summary: This message opens chapter three of Grant von Harrison's book, detailing how to systematically choose and achieve goals by drawing on the powers of heaven. It highlights that dedication alone is not enough; we must specifically ask God for precise blessings to establish a relationship beyond mechanical obedience. Backed by counsel from President Spencer W. Kimball, the text breaks down goals into two categories—action-driven and power-driven—and cautions that goals must be treated as ongoing means rather than stagnant endpoints to avoid spiritual plateaus.
